{{Mergeto|Gamma ray/Legends}}
'''Gamma radiation''' was a form of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. This type of radiation could be absorbed and dissipated by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] using [[Tutaminis]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
